description.zh: 馬迷在歡笑聲中參與現場趣味小遊戲
description.en: Bronies participating in fun live games, sharing laughter and teamwork.

description.zh: 考驗馬迷對動畫與劇情的了解，現場互動踴躍、爭相搶答！
description.en: Testing bronies' knowledge of the show with exciting trivia and active audience response.

description.zh: 馬迷們在創作者攤位前熱烈交流與選購精美周邊。
description.en: Bronies browsing and chatting with local brony creators at their booths.

description.zh: 馬迷們在交誼區聊天、玩桌遊並結識志同道合的新朋友。
description.en: Bronies playing tabletop games and making new friends in the social area.

description.zh: 夜場「彩虹音爆」派對中，DJ帶來節奏強烈的小馬混音舞曲狂歡。
description.en: DJs hyping up the audience with pony remixes during the Sonic Rainboom night.

description.zh: 全場同好在大合唱時間齊聲高歌經典彩虹小馬歌曲，為大會畫下溫馨句點。
description.en: Everyone gathering to sing their favorite pony songs together to close the con.

description.zh: 所有與會小馬迷的歡樂合影！
description.en: A joyful group photo of all attending pony fans!
